keyFindings.description: resolveExisting (config.go:436-462) duplicates resolvedPath (gitworktree.go:93-110) in the same package: both EvalSymlinks the longest existing prefix and rejoin the missing tail. Delete resolveExisting and its comment and call resolvedPath.

The refusal says two false things about jj 0.45.1, measured in $TMPDIR: (a) a `.jj` that is a file is not 'jj's own workspace pointer form' (config.go:404-405) — jj counts only a `.jj` directory and answers 'There is no jj repo' under a `.jj` file, so the code refuses what jj ignores and the test row enclosingrepository_test.go:296 pins the false claim; (b) 'jj would open and write that one instead of creating it' (config.go:424, also :224-225 and enclosingrepository_test.go:271-273) — `jj git init --colocate c` run inside repository b migrates b's legacy config (writes b/.jj/repo/config-id) and also creates c. Match jj (os.Stat + IsDir, the file row becomes an allowed row) and make the message say jj reads and rewrites that repository's configuration; also name the resolved directory when it differs from the lexical one (the tester's observation in test.json).

Repeats the 'a state directory inside it' subtest (enclosingrepository_test.go:55-72) step for step, and the copies drifted: the original asserts the lexical filepath.Join(decoy, ".jj") (:68) while production names the resolved path, so it fails wherever t.TempDir() sits under a symlink (macOS /var). The copy's comment cites config.go:352-353, which this PR moved to :375-376, and says the base wrote the operator's repository 'exactly as it did before the fix', which the test does not show (it never t.Chdir's). Fold the symlink case into the subtest as a second row, assert against the EvalSymlinks'd decoy, cite refuseSymlinkedLayout by name, delete the file.

The change adds refusals at a package boundary (workspace.Runner.Run, exported, refuses a Command with no absolute Dir; a jj create command under any `.jj`) and at a process boundary (legion workspace-init provision and the tmux daemon refuse a state_dir under a jj checkout), so the body needs a '## Contract change census': the search commands, each hit with its disposition (cmd/legion/workspace_init.go:154, workspace_fetch.go:79, workspace_cache.go:61, internal/daemon/daemon.go:918, outbox.go:152,160,163, repocache/server_test.go:75, sandbox/live_setup_unit_test.go:874), and a rollout line: an immediate refusal naming what it closes (the silent write of an enclosing repository).

:64 and jjWorkspaceRoot's comment (config.go:549-556) imply -R keeps jj off the working directory's repository; jj 0.45.1 loads it anyway (`jj -R b log` run inside a wrote a/.jj/repo/config-id, measured), so every -R command is safe only because its Dir is its -R target — say so. :71 names requireFilters, which this PR deleted (testbin.RequireJJFilters). :77 claims a TMPDIR inside a checkout refuses rather than corrupts, but the fixtures' own `jj git init --colocate` (runSetup, enclosingRepository) run outside the runner's refusal.

The body says every git and jj child a daemon test starts names a directory, and docs/testing.md:68 says set Dir on every one; live_setup_unit_test.go:1041 and bookmark_test.go:359 still use `git -C` with no Dir. Set Dir there.
